chapters.label: Live: the EURO 2026 final
chapters.text: The 2026 Futsal EURO final, in Ljubljana. Spain play Portugal. Pablo Ramírez is Spain’s pivot, up front. In the second minute, he sets up Antonio Pérez. Goal! Spain win, five to three!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: This is how he does it. Back to goal, the ball comes in. He holds it up and keeps the defender behind. A teammate runs in. He lays it off. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Hold it, lay it off, shot!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: hold the ball up and lay it off for a teammate running in to shoot!
